# WallpaperBat

> A curated collection of high-quality 4K and HD wallpapers featuring popular gaming characters, horror themes, and internet culture phenomena.

WallpaperBat specializes in desktop and mobile backgrounds from trending games like Poppy Playtime, horror content including The Backrooms creepypasta, and fan art sourced from communities like ArtStation and Steam. All wallpapers are available in multiple resolutions for optimal display quality.
